arguments.rule_content:
title: Legacy Firewall Rule Detection
id: a43802b3-9f68-46be-9513-001d6ca97d8a
status: experimental
description: Detect potential legacy firewall rules that may pose security risks
references:
    - https://mitre.org/techniques/T1210
author: SOC Content Team
date: 2026/04/10
modified: 2026/04/10
logic: any of them
detectors:
    - selector: firewall.log
    - |   
        rule_age_days = (now() - firewall.rule.creation_time) / (24 * 3600)
        rule_age_days > 180
        firewall.rule.action == 'Allow'
        (  firewall.rule.protocol == 'TCP'
        and firewall.rule.dst_ports == '3389'
        )
        (  member(firewall.rule.name, [ 'LEGACY*', '*OLD*', '*TEMP*', '*TEST*' ])
        or contains(firewall.rule.description, 'legacy')
        or contains(firewall.rule.description, 'temporary')
        )
        not member(firewall.rule.src_ips, ['approved_ips_list'])
        not member(firewall.rule.dst_ips, ['trusted_zones'])
    - selector: firewall.rule_change
    - |       
        rule_change_age_days = (now() - firewall.rule_change.timestamp) / (24 * 3600)
        rule_change_age_days > 30
        firewall.rule_change.action == 'Created'
        return $msg, $rule.rule_name, $rule.creation_time, $rule.src_ips, $rule.dst_ips
falsepositives:
    - Approved legacy rules with compensating controls in place
level: high
